'''Corellian Engineering Corporation tournament reports''' are the tournament reports on the [[Corellian Engineering Corporation (fan site)|Corellian Engineering Corporation]], the GeoCities fan site [[Alex Alcalde]] ran for the Corellia region. Its "Tourny Reports" page linked nine reports from Indiana tournaments and [[DecipherCon 1999]].<ref name="cec-articles">[http://www.geocities.com/CollegePark/Plaza/9433/articles.html Tourny Reports], Corellian Engineering Corporation fan site (GeoCities). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20001014155851/http://www.geocities.com:80/CollegePark/Plaza/9433/articles.html Internet Archive]</ref> The site also carried Alcalde's report on the [[1999 Corellia Regionals]], taken from Decipher's NewsFlash.<ref name="cec-reg">[http://www.geocities.com/CollegePark/Plaza/9433/regional.html 1999 Corellia Regional Championship], Alex Alcalde, Corellian Engineering Corporation fan site (GeoCities). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20000618013958/http://www.geocities.com:80/CollegePark/Plaza/9433/regional.html Internet Archive]</ref> The site's reports are undated. They survive in Wayback captures of the GeoCities pages and of the OoCities mirror. Each has its own article, part of [[Tournament reports]].
